roles.prompt: Analyze candles, swings, structure breaks, trend, ranges, reaction quality and price action context.
Visually inspect the chart for structure, patterns, levels, trend lines and inconsistencies. Do not hallucinate unseen chart data.
Analyze BOS/CHOCH, liquidity pools, displacement, order-block style zones and structural invalidation without treating SMC terminology as certainty.
Identify support/resistance, supply/demand, repeated reactions, break/retest behavior and invalidation zones.
Interpret provided indicators in context; avoid indicator-only trade decisions and flag divergences/conflicts.
Assess momentum strength, acceleration/deceleration and divergence using available price/indicator data.
Classify trend/range/transition regime and explain what evidence would invalidate the regime.
Compare available timeframes and identify alignment or conflict between higher-timeframe context and lower-timeframe setup.
Assess volatility state, expansion/compression and execution risk.
Use available volume/order-flow/liquidity data to identify imbalances and execution context. State when such data is unavailable.
Analyze company/asset fundamentals supplied in context and distinguish durable fundamentals from short-term market narrative.
Analyze supplied news sentiment, relevance, recency and likely market sensitivity; avoid treating sentiment as direction certainty.
Analyze macro drivers such as rates, inflation, currency, liquidity and risk sentiment when data is provided.
Analyze options/futures positioning, OI, volatility and derivative-specific risk using supplied data.
Interpret time-series forecast output probabilistically. Focus on uncertainty bands, regime sensitivity and forecast failure modes.
Challenge the setup. Identify invalidation, downside scenarios, position-sizing concerns, leverage risk, gap/liquidity risk and conditions to avoid the trade.
Assess correlation, concentration, portfolio exposure and potential hedges based only on supplied holdings/exposures.
Choose which strategy family fits the detected regime and explain why other strategies are unsuitable.
Evaluate whether the thesis is testable, which assumptions require historical validation, and what backtest biases to avoid.
Act as an independent skeptical reviewer of the overall opportunity. Look for contradictions, missing data and overconfidence before agreeing with a directional thesis.
